next:or:408.hint: よくあることを表す疑似関係代名詞as
next:or:408.question: She was late, [[as it is often the case with her]].
next:or:408.answer: as is often the case with her
next:or:408.fullSentence: She was late, as is often the case with her.
next:or:408.wrongPart: as it is often the case with her
next:or:408.explanation: as is the case (with A)『(Aについては)よくあることだが』。疑似関係代名詞as。
next:or:408.relatedInfo: often, usuallyなどの副詞を伴うことも多い。

next:or:409.hint: 彼についてはいつものことだが、遅刻した
next:or:409.fullSentence: He was late, as is usual with him.
next:or:409.explanation: as is usual (with A)『(Aについては)いつものことだが』。疑似関係代名詞as。
next:or:409.relatedInfo: as is the case (with A)とほぼ同義。

next:or:410.hint: 習慣的な行動を説明する疑似関係代名詞as
next:or:410.question: He complained, [[as is his way him]].
next:or:410.answer: as is the way with him
next:or:410.fullSentence: He complained, as is the way with him.
next:or:410.explanation: as is the way (with A)『(Aについては)いつものことだが』。
next:or:410.relatedInfo: as is the case/usualと同グループの慣用表現。

next:or:411.hint: 前文の内容を受けて挿入的に使われる関係代名詞
next:or:411.fullSentence: As is well known, the earth is round.
next:or:411.explanation: 疑似関係代名詞asは前の文の内容を先行詞とし、関係代名詞節の中にSVが挿入される用法。
next:or:411.relatedInfo: As is well known, ~『よく知られているように』のような文頭用法もある。

next:or:412.hint: 彼女が適任だと思った男を雇った
next:or:412.fullSentence: She hired a man who she thought was right for the job.
next:or:412.explanation: a man who she thought was right『彼女が正しいと思った男』。she thoughtが関係代名詞節に挿入された形(連鎖関係詞節)。
next:or:412.relatedInfo: whoの後にshe thoughtが挿入されている。

next:or:413.hint: 連鎖関係詞節を含むwhat構文
next:or:413.question: Do [[that you think is right]].
next:or:413.fullSentence: Do what you think is right.
next:or:413.explanation: what you think is right『あなたが正しいと思うこと』。you thinkが関係代名詞節に挿入された連鎖関係詞節。
next:or:413.relatedInfo: a man who she thought was rightと同じ構造。

next:or:414.hint: 彼が到着したとき、みんな立ち上がった
next:or:414.fullSentence: When he arrived, everyone stood up.
next:or:414.explanation: when『〜するとき』。時を表す接続詞。
next:or:414.relatedInfo: since, before, until, by the time, as soon asなども同じ時を表すグループ。

next:or:415.hint: 倒置を伴う『〜するとすぐに』の強調表現
next:or:415.question: [[No sooner he had left home than]] it began to rain.
next:or:415.answer: No sooner had he left home than
next:or:415.fullSentence: No sooner had he left home than it began to rain.
next:or:415.wrongPart: No sooner he had left home than
next:or:415.explanation: no sooner ~ than『〜するとすぐに』。文頭に出ると倒置が起こる。

next:or:416.hint: 雨が降っていたので、私たちは家にいた
next:or:416.fullSentence: Since it was raining, we stayed home.
next:or:416.relatedInfo: sinceは『すでにわかっている理由』を導くことが多い。

next:or:417.hint: 『もし〜でなければ』を表す接続詞
next:or:417.question: You will miss the train [[if]] you hurry.
next:or:417.fullSentence: You will miss the train unless you hurry.
next:or:417.explanation: unless『もし〜でなければ』。if ... notに近い意味。
next:or:417.relatedInfo: unless節の中では否定語を重ねないのが基本。

next:or:418.hint: 宿題を終わらせるならば、テレビを見てもいい
next:or:418.fullSentence: Provided (that) you finish your homework, you can watch TV.
next:or:418.relatedInfo: ifよりもやや条件を強調するニュアンス。

next:or:419.hint: 事実に反する様子を表す接続詞
next:or:419.question: He behaved [[even if]] he knew nothing.
next:or:419.fullSentence: He behaved as if he knew nothing.
next:or:419.explanation: as if『まるで〜であるかのように』。

next:or:420.hint: 彼は若いけれども、とても責任感がある
next:or:420.fullSentence: Although he is young, he is very responsible.
next:or:420.relatedInfo: thoughとほぼ同義だが、althoughの方がやや堅い表現。

next:or:421.hint: 仮定的な状況への譲歩を表す接続詞
next:or:421.question: [[Even though]] it rains, we will leave.
next:or:421.fullSentence: Even if it rains, we will leave.
next:or:421.explanation: even if『たとえ〜としても』。仮定的な状況への譲歩。
next:or:421.relatedInfo: even though(事実への譲歩)との違いに注意。

next:or:422.hint: 彼はお金持ちだけれども、質素な生活をしている(事実への譲歩)
next:or:422.fullSentence: Even though he is rich, he lives a simple life.
next:or:422.explanation: even though『たとえ〜でも』。事実として成立していることへの譲歩。
next:or:422.relatedInfo: even if(仮定)との違いに注意。

next:or:423.hint: 2つの選択肢どちらでも、を表す接続詞
next:or:423.question: [[If we win or lose]], I will do my best.
next:or:423.fullSentence: Whether we win or lose, I will do my best.
next:or:423.relatedInfo: whether A or Bの形で2つの可能性を並べる。

next:or:424.hint: asが持つ多様な意味のグループ分け
next:or:424.fullSentence: As she grew older, she became wiser.
next:or:424.explanation: asの5用法: 時・比例・理由・様態・譲歩。目的はasではなくso that等で表す。
next:or:424.relatedInfo: 文脈からasの意味を判断する必要がある。

next:or:425.hint: 家に歩いて帰っている間に、雨が降り始めた(時)
next:or:425.fullSentence: As I was walking home, it started to rain.

next:or:426.hint: 変化が並行して進むことを表すasの用法
next:or:426.question: [[As he grows older]], he became wiser.
next:or:426.fullSentence: As he grew older, he became wiser.
next:or:426.explanation: as(比例)『〜するにつれて』。2つの変化が並行して進むことを表す。
next:or:426.relatedInfo: the 比較級, the 比較級 の構文と似た意味を持つことがある。

next:or:427.hint: 遅かったので、私たちは家に帰ることにした(理由)
next:or:427.fullSentence: As it was late, we decided to go home.
next:or:427.relatedInfo: becauseよりも軽い理由を表すことが多い。

next:or:428.hint: 様子・方法を表すasの用法
next:or:428.question: Do [[that he told you]].
next:or:428.explanation: as(様態)『〜するように/〜のとおりに』。
next:or:428.relatedInfo: Do as I say. のような命令文でよく使われる。

next:or:429.hint: 暗かったけれども、私たちは道を見つけた(譲歩の倒置)
next:or:429.fullSentence: Dark as it was, we found the way.
next:or:429.explanation: 形容詞+as+S+V『〜だけれども』(譲歩の倒置構文)。asは譲歩の意味。
next:or:429.relatedInfo: Although it was dark, ~ と同義。

next:or:430.hint: 様態を強調するasの慣用表現
next:or:430.question: It rained, [[just as he say]].
next:or:430.fullSentence: It rained, just as he said.
next:or:430.explanation: just as ~『ちょうど〜のように』。

next:or:431.hint: 彼は良い父親だが、(実際は)悪い夫だ
next:or:431.fullSentence: He is a good father, though he is a poor husband.
next:or:431.explanation: A is B, though『Aは(実際は)〜だけれど』。thoughを文末近くに置いて対比を加える口語的用法。
next:or:431.relatedInfo: 文末のthoughは『でも』のような軽い接続を表す。

next:or:432.hint: asと近い意味を持つ前置詞
next:or:432.question: He behaves [[as]] his father.
next:or:432.explanation: like(=as)『〜のように』。前置詞としての用法。
next:or:432.relatedInfo: asは接続詞・前置詞両方の用法があるが、likeは主に前置詞。
